title: Point-cloud asset metadata (v1.3)
description: Index record for a point-cloud FILE on disk. Files live in the project storage directory; databases only store this metadata. v1.1 (Stage 2.1) added optional provenance, checksum, scale-status and validation fields. v1.2 (Stage 3 planning correction) adds the optional `reconstruction` provenance block for clouds produced by `pointcloud_reconstruction`; Stage 3.0 finalization extends that block with pipeline_path and makes trajectory_id nullable for COLMAP-native clouds. v1.3 (Stage 3.1) widens coordinate_units to allow `unit_unknown` and coordinate_convention to allow `source_documented` (imported coordinates are stored as-is; the app never claims the units or axis mapping a source file does not state), and adds the optional `original_filename` and `content` fields. All v1.3 additions are optional or widenings: every earlier-v document remains valid unchanged. Point clouds come from import or reconstruction only.

file_path.description: Path relative to the project storage directory.

coordinate_units.description: Storage unit of the FILE. v1.3: `unit_unknown` is required for imported files whose format does not document a unit (XYZ, most PLY) — units are never assumed. `metre` is claimed only when the source format forces a unit or a documented transform established it. Whether those metres are real-world metric is decided ONLY by scale_status/scale_provenance.

enum: right-handed +X east +Y north +Z up, local origin
coordinate_convention.description: v1.3: for IMPORTED files the value is `source_documented` — coordinates are stored exactly as the source documents (or, when it documents no convention, exactly as stored); the app applied no transform and asserts no axis mapping. The explicit default string is reserved for clouds this app produced, where the pipeline genuinely establishes it. Local scan coordinates are NOT geographically referenced unless an explicit transform is stored alongside.

original_filename.description: v1.3 — original file name as imported.

content.description: v1.3 — content facts read from the file itself during validation; never guessed.

source_session_ids.description: Capture sessions that contributed to this cloud; for imports, the session it was filed under.

checksum_md5.description: MD5 of the file bytes, computed when the record is written.

provenance.description: How this cloud came to exist. Required for imported/fused/reconstructed clouds once produced.

reconstruction.description: v1.2 — full reconstruction provenance; required when provenance.kind is 'reconstructed'.

scale_status.description: Metric-scale verdict for this cloud. Absent means UNKNOWN; never silently assume real-world metre scale.

coordinate_properties.description: Property names the file itself uses for coordinates (e.g. x/y/z).

crs.description: CRS identifier/description taken from the file's own metadata, or null when the file carries none.

tool.description: Software/library and version that produced the file.

trajectory_id.description: Mandatory for opencv_assisted clouds; may be null for colmap_native clouds whose poses were estimated inside COLMAP.

pipeline_path.description: Which declared reconstruction path produced this cloud (Stage 3.0 finalization).

reconstruction-provenance.description: Traceability for reconstructed clouds: every geometry product must be traceable to its calibration, poses and extraction jobs, and state which reconstruction path produced it.

basis.description: Genuine evidence for the metric claim. A camera calibration alone is NOT a scale basis.

scale-provenance.description: Rules: UNKNOWN pairs with basis 'none'; operator_assumed stays ESTIMATED at best; VALIDATED requires independent metric evidence (known_dimension, survey_control, validated_depth, external_metric_scan).
